description: Kernel-mystery probe (T-1778): does the shape-0.5 kernel work from z alone or from x = sqrt(z)? Consecutive z mantissas, so about half the z are not squares of doubles. A = z = M*2^E, B = GAMMA.DIST(z,0.5,1,TRUE), C = ERF.PRECISE(SQRT(z)), D = CHISQ.DIST(2z,1,TRUE), E = SQRT(z) (first 32 rows of each run). If B = C everywhere, GAMMA.DIST goes through erf(sqrt z); where B != C the kernel reads z beyond sqrt(z) and a rounding step lies between z and fl(sqrt z)^2.
